notes.title: Hell is Us | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/c46b763bbe78c771a5b21a71d595ccabf3357204.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]· Interact actions can now be remapped.[/p][p align="start"]· Weapon information panel now displays charge attack damage values.[/p][p align="start"]· Timeloop designation (tier and codename) is now shown in the Exploration tab of the datapad.[/p][p align="start"]· Drone Translation and Observation screens feature a larger text window.[/p][p align="start"]· Last consumable item now remains in the loadout with a quantity of 0.[/p][p align="start"]· Crafting of items is blocked if there isn’t enough inventory space.[/p][p align="start"]· Player’s HUD bar will dynamically hide even when a permanent buff is active.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]· Fixed a rare issue preventing interaction with the rotating door puzzle after the Monsters Do Exist cinematic.[/p][p align="start"]· Endgame save is now created after the cinematic, allowing players to retrigger it in case of a crash.[/p][p align="start"]· Fixed a potential crash when traveling to the Auriga Museum.[/p][p align="start"]· Gluttony Glyph behavior now correctly matches its description.[/p][p align="start"]· Various fixes for input remapping and display.[/p][p align="start"]· Removed stutter when sliding down ladders with camera movement lag value below 1.[/p][p align="start"]· Fixed potential issue with incorrect character rotation when using ladders.[/p][p align="start"]· Exiting the Navigation map while selecting a travel destination no longer causes a soft lock.[/p][p align="start"]· Subtitles now behave correctly when crafting, researching, or pausing.[/p][p align="start"]· Fixed multiple level collision issues.[/p][p align="start"]· Fixed various audio issues.[/p][p align="start"]· Fixed various rare crashes.[/p][p align="start"]· Fixed multiple UI issues.[/p][p align="start"]· Fixed several combat issues.[/p][p align="start"]· Achievements/Trophies now calculate correctly if data was accumulated in another save slot or in the demo. This affects the following:[/p][p align="start"]o Man of the People[/p][p align="start"]o Super-Sleuth[/p][p align="start"]o Good Vibrations[/p][p align="start"]o Tech-Savvy[/p][p align="start"]o Emotional Damage[/p][p align="start"]o Emotional Warfade[/p][p align="start"]o Curator[/p][p align="start"]o Antiquarian[/p][p align="start"]o Keymaster[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]Tweaks[/b][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]· Default HDR minimum luminance changed to 3.[/p][p align="start"]· Animosity Glyph behavior improved.[/p][p align="start"]· Teleport skills now better detect the environment.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]PC Only[/b][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]· Monitor selection is now available in video settings.[/p][p align="start"]· DLSS Frame Generation no longer requires a game restart.[/p][p align="start"]· Upscalers and Frame Generators now exclude themselves correctly.[/p][p align="start"]

[b]Xbox Series X Only[/b][/p][p align="start"]· Potential fix for crash in Quality Mode when traveling to APC or another map.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Additionally, multiple optimizations and bug fixes have also been applied to improve overall stability and gameplay experience.[/p]

tags.feature: · Interact actions can now be remapped.
· Weapon information panel now displays charge attack damage values.
· Timeloop designation (tier and codename) is now shown in the Exploration tab of the datapad.
· Drone Translation and Observation screens feature a larger text window.
· Last consumable item now remains in the loadout with a quantity of 0.
· Crafting of items is blocked if there isn’t enough inventory space.
· Player’s HUD bar will dynamically hide even when a permanent buff is active.

tags.bug: · Fixed a rare issue preventing interaction with the rotating door puzzle after the Monsters Do Exist cinematic.
· Endgame save is now created after the cinematic, allowing players to retrigger it in case of a crash.
· Fixed a potential crash when traveling to the Auriga Museum.
· Gluttony Glyph behavior now correctly matches its description.
· Various fixes for input remapping and display.
· Removed stutter when sliding down ladders with camera movement lag value below 1.
· Fixed potential issue with incorrect character rotation when using ladders.
· Exiting the Navigation map while selecting a travel destination no longer causes a soft lock.
· Subtitles now behave correctly when crafting, researching, or pausing.
· Achievements/Trophies now calculate correctly if data was accumulated in another save slot or in the demo.

tags.balance_change: · Default HDR minimum luminance changed to 3.
· Teleport skills now better detect the environment.

tags.feature: · Monitor selection is now available in video settings.
· DLSS Frame Generation no longer requires a game restart.
· Upscalers and Frame Generators now exclude themselves correctly.

tags.bug: · Potential fix for crash in Quality Mode when traveling to APC or another map.

notes.title: HELL IS US – New Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][b]The Hell is Us demo is back! It will be available at 3 PM CEST / 6 AM PT.[/b][/p][p]
Months after its first appearance, the demo returns — now enhanced with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and refined gameplay to make your return to Hadea even smoother. Here’s what’s changed since the last time you played:[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🎥 New Camera Options[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Camera Follow[/b] toggle on/off.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement Lag[/b] and [b]Rotation Lag[/b] adjustments for smoother control.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📦 New Inventory Organisation[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]Favorites[/b] and [b]Archives[/b] tabs for quicker access to your items.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]⚙️ New Difficulty Screen[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Choose your preferred difficulty level more easily.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📟 Optimisation[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Graphics improvements — now playable in 4K at 60 FPS, among other enhancements.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📸 Photo Mode Added[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Capture your most stunning moments directly in-game.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🌍 Added Localisations[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]French voice-over[/b] now available.[/p][/*][*][p]Text language support for [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]Japanese[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🗡️ Parry & Riposte Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]While all attacks can be blocked, only certain attacks can now be parried, triggering a counter-attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]visual cue[/b] for parryable attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]dedicated tutorial[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Riposte camera sequence now only plays [b]once every 5 to 10 ripostes[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎯 Lock-On / Targeting Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added up/down switching when enemies, at the centre of the screen, are in front of one another.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother camera movement.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📟 Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Datapad full boot screen only shows the [b]first time[/b] you open it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiple bug fixes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various optimisations[/b] for better performance.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Whether you played the first demo or are discovering [b]Hell is Us[/b] for the very first time, now’s the perfect moment to jump back in and see what’s new.
We look forward to hearing your feedback — see you in Hadea.[/p]

tags.feature: Camera Follow toggle on/off.
Movement Lag and Rotation Lag adjustments for smoother control.
Added Favorites and Archives tabs for quicker access to your items.
Choose your preferred difficulty level more easily.
Graphics improvements — now playable in 4K at 60 FPS, among other enhancements.
Capture your most stunning moments directly in-game.
French voice-over now available.
Text language support for Chinese and Japanese.

tags.balance_change: While all attacks can be blocked, only certain attacks can now be parried, triggering a counter-attack.

tags.feature: Added a visual cue for parryable attacks.
New dedicated tutorial.

tags.balance_change: Riposte camera sequence now only plays once every 5 to 10 ripostes.

tags.feature: Added up/down switching when enemies, at the centre of the screen, are in front of one another.
Smoother camera movement.
Datapad full boot screen only shows the first time you open it.
Various optimisations for better performance.
